title: Nmsdk I2C Hub (climate/ToF/IMU/power/env extras)
notes: Bundled Uno/Mega HEX enables BME280, VL53L0X, INA219 and PCA9685. MPU6050 and other catalog sensors require a custom build with their NMSDK_I2C_HUB_* flag and matching libraries enabled; MPU6050 is off by default to fit the Uno flash limit.
